content: Instruction files: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md not AGENTS.md (cli/cli 14075); claude-code 7777 reports agents treating CLAUDE.md as advisory; long files degrade adherence (roughly 150-200 instruction budget). arXiv 2602.11988: context files do not improve success rate and add about 20 percent cost; instructions are followed but files are poor repo overviews. Claude Code docs: skill content is not re-read on later turns and can be lost after compaction; use hooks to enforce deterministically.
